description: Visual Markdown editor with Mermaid diagrams, frontmatter, PDF export and printing. Notes stay ordinary Markdown files in your workspace.
untrusted: In Restricted Mode, the PDF template folder from workspace settings is ignored.
config.templateFolder: PDF template folder (containing `stil.css`, `vorlage.json`, …). Leave empty to export without a template. A vault assignment in `.merkzeug/settings.json` takes precedence. Use the **Merkzeug: PDF Template Settings…** command to pick a folder, the bundled starter or a desktop template.
config.pdfTemplatePreview: Apply the content styles of the assigned PDF template while editing. Toolbar, dialogs and VS Code controls keep the VS Code theme.
config.browserPath: Chromium-based browser used for PDF export and printing (Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Chromium or Brave). Leave empty to detect an installed browser automatically.
config.companionFolders: When a Markdown note is renamed or moved in VS Code, also move its `Note.assets/` companion folder and update Markdown links in the workspace.
